column1: # kinds.tsv (harbor#950) — every kind of artifact, where it lives and what it must carry.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A kind was a table in prose (standards/naming.md §4), so the lint could not say
# "this file is kind X, so it needs fields Y in folder Z" and each rule hardcoded its own slice (09a S1).
# One row per kind term (terms.tsv, class kind) states the folder, the path pattern, the surface that
# names it, the metadata it carries, the layer and level it sits at and how it ages. Every kind term has
# exactly one row. Whether a given path conforms is a later check; today the lint refuses a row that
# names a layer, level, lifecycle or surface the registry does not have.
# The kind and layer of each top-level repo entry are mapped in contracts/layout-map.tsv (harbor#1272), checked by bin/lint-layout-map.sh.
# COLUMNS  id <TAB> folder <TAB> path_pattern <TAB> surface <TAB> required_fields <TAB> layer <TAB> level
#   id               a terms.tsv term of class kind
#   folder           the root folder of the kind, or - when it is not a repo folder
#   path_pattern     where one artifact lives; <placeholders> are the grammar's slots
#   surface          the surfaces.tsv id that renders the artifact's name
#   required_fields  space-separated metadata fields the artifact carries (front matter, a header, a column), or -
#   layer            source | generated | deployed | record | report (terms.tsv, class layer)
#   level            the containment level the artifact sits at (terms.tsv, class level; D-57)
#   lifecycle        versioned | dated | living | generated | append-only (terms.tsv, class lifecycle)
#   generator        the command that regenerates a generated kind, or -
#   required_relations  space-separated shapes <relation>[:<min>..<max>], or -: a relation term (terms.tsv, class relation)
#                    an instance must carry, and how many distinct targets it may have; max * is unbounded, a bare name
#                    is 1..*. Checked: each name is a relation term and each bound is well formed (bin/lint-name.sh).
#                    Judged by bin/standard-shape.sh over build/graph.tsv, on the catalog's instances of the kind
#   share            the SET of shares a kind may take, comma-separated: core | hub | workload | personal (terms.tsv, class share).
#                    An instance's share comes from where it lives: harbor checkout core, workload repo (and its
#                    harbor-pack/) workload, harbor-private personal (its hub/ part hub); bin/lint-share.sh judges it (D-83, harbor#1274)
#   note             the decision or section that places it
